evidence.evidence_text: To fill this gap, we construct a Chinese CS conversation (CSConv) dataset, which contains about 2.6K groups of dialogues with therapy principles and emotional support strategy labels.
Data sparsity is the main challenge in building CS-based dialogue systems, particularly in the Chinese language.
Extensive experiments conducted on the CSConv dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, while there is still a large space for improvement compared to human performance.
When communicating with elders with cognitive impairment, cognitive stimulation (CS) help to maintain the cognitive health of elders.

We first use a progressive mask method based on external knowledge to learn encoders as effective classifiers, which is the prerequisite to predict the therapy principle and emotional support strategy of the target response.
